Box 1 Example short deﬁnitions of famine
1. An extreme crisis of inaccessibility to adequate food, manifested in widespread malnutrition and loss of life due to starvation and infectious disease (Maxwell and
Majid, 2016).
2. Sustained, extreme shortages of food among discrete populations sufﬁcient to cause high rates of mortality (Scrimshaw, 1987).
3. The most severe form of food insecurity, during which mass starvation and death take place within a relatively short span of time (Yip, 1997).
